value.description: Value replaces the saved value, empty keeps the saved one.

draftVersion.description: DraftVersion is the draft version the edit is based on, 409 is returned if someone else has saved it.

component.description: Component is the control to render the item.

default.description: Default is the initial value when configuring a new field.

fieldTypes.description: FieldTypes limits the fields of field_select, empty allows all the fields except formulas.

key.description: Key is the key of the configured value in FieldShortcut.Inputs and of the parameter passed to the shortcut.

label.description: Label is the name of the item shown in the form.

options.description: Options are the choices of select.

placeholder.description: Placeholder is the hint of the empty input.

required.description: Required reports whether the item must be filled in before saving or executing.

label.description: Label is the text of the option shown in the form.

value.description: Value is the configured value of the option.

error.description: Error is the reason of the failure, or of the last attempt of a pending retry.

fieldUID.description: FieldUID is the field of the cell.

recordUID.description: RecordUID is the record of the cell.

status.description: Status is done when the job is removed, which is only sent over WebSocket.

error.description: Error is the reason of the failure, empty if succeeded.

value.description: Value is the cell value of the field, null if empty or failed.

password.description: Password is limited to 64 characters since bcrypt only uses the first 72 bytes.

allowPasswordSignIn.description: AllowPasswordSignIn being false shows only the third-party sign-in on the sign-in page, admins can still use a password.

loginNotice.description: LoginNotice is the plain text shown above the sign-in form, empty if hidden.

providers.description: Providers are the enabled and usable sign-in methods in the order of the admin console.

columns.description: Columns are the imported columns and their target fields.

headerRow.description: HeaderRow uses the first row as the field titles instead of importing it.

sheet.description: Sheet is the index of the sheet in the upload response.

tableName.description: TableName is the name of the new table, required if TableUID is empty.

tableUID.description: TableUID is the existing table to append the records to.

timezone.description: Timezone is the IANA time zone of the dates without a time zone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai.

viewName.description: ViewName is the name of the grid view of the new table.

fieldUID.description: FieldUID is the existing target field.

index.description: Index is the zero-based index of the column in the sheet.

label.description: Label is the title of the new field.

type.description: Type is the type of the new field.

allowPasswordSignIn.description: AllowPasswordSignIn being false allows only the admins to sign in with email and password.

allowSignUp.description: AllowSignUp reports whether new users can sign up by themselves.

externalURL.description: ExternalURL is the address users visit (e.g. https://sayrud.example.com), the callback URLs of third-party sign-in are built on it, empty if not set.

loginNotice.description: LoginNotice is the plain text shown above the sign-in form, empty if hidden.

networkAllowlist.description: NetworkAllowlist permits shortcut fetches to these otherwise blocked IP addresses or CIDRs.

passwordMinLength.description: PasswordMinLength applies to signing up, changing, creating and resetting passwords.

sessionTTLDays.description: SessionTTLDays is the lifetime in days of the new sessions.

siteName.description: SiteName is shown in the page title and the sign-in page.

durationMs.description: DurationMs is the time of the request in milliseconds.

reply.description: Reply is the content returned by the model, truncated to 500 characters.

bindPassword.description: BindPassword is the password of the LDAP service account.

id.description: ID is the saved provider whose secrets are used if empty, 0 when creating.

username.description: Username is the LDAP user to search, optional.

credentialUID.description: CredentialUID provides the saved secrets for the fields not given.

input.description: Input holds the values of test.fields in the credential type DSL, e.g. the recipient of the test email.

params.description: Params are passed to execute as is, keyed by the form item key.

shortcut.description: Shortcut is the unsaved shortcut to run.

uid.description: UID is the saved shortcut whose credential values are used if the values are not given.

cellValue.description: CellValue is the value converted for a field of the result type, select fields are not converted as there are no options.

durationMs.description: DurationMs is the time of the run in milliseconds.

error.description: Error is the reason of the failure, empty if succeeded.

logs.description: Logs are the lines printed by console and context.log, with the credential values redacted.

value.description: Value is the value returned by execute, before converting to the cell value.

config.description: Config is passed to execute as is, so credential fields hold the credential values.

error.description: Error is the reason of the failure, empty if succeeded.

fetches.description: Fetches is the number of the requests made by ctx.fetch.

logs.description: Logs are the lines printed by console and ctx.log.

value.description: Value is the value returned by the hook.

apiKey.description: APIKey replaces the saved one, empty keeps the saved one.

baseURL.description: BaseURL is the API root including the version, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

clearAPIKey.description: ClearAPIKey removes the saved API key, it is ignored if APIKey is given.

enabled.description: Enabled reports whether the global AI model is enabled.

model.description: Model is the name of the model to call, it is required if enabled.

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds is the timeout of a completion request, between 1 and 120.

bindPassword.description: BindPassword is the password of the LDAP service account, empty keeps the saved one when updating.

clientSecret.description: ClientSecret is the client secret of OAuth 2.0 or OIDC, empty keeps the saved one when updating.

metadata.description: Metadata replaces the whole field configuration, it is required when the type changes.

position.description: Position is the zero-based index the field moves to, it is clamped into the valid range.

password.description: Nil preserves the password, an empty string disables it.

color.description: Color is orange, coral, pink, purple, indigo, blue, teal or green; an empty string resets the color.

icon.description: Icon is a lowercase kebab-case identifier, an empty string resets the icon.

data.description: Data replaces all the cell values of the record, keyed by field UID.

externalURL.description: ExternalURL is the external URL of the site, empty if not set.

loginNotice.description: LoginNotice is the plain text shown above the sign-in form, empty if hidden.

networkAllowlist.description: NetworkAllowlist permits shortcut fetches to these otherwise blocked IP addresses or CIDRs.

current.description: Current reports whether it is the session of the current request.

language.description: Language is the language of the user interface.

theme.description: Theme is the appearance of the user interface.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: HasUnpublishedChanges indicates the draft has been modified since the latest publishing.

issues.description: Issues are the issues in the draft that must be fixed before publishing.

method.description: Method and Path are the entry of the API trigger in the draft, empty for other triggers.

publishedMethod.description: PublishedMethod and PublishedPath are the API entry being served, empty if unpublished or for other triggers.

triggerType.description: TriggerType is the trigger type of the draft, PublishedTriggerType is the trigger type of the published revision, empty if unpublished.

method.description: Method is GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

path.description: Path is a static path relative to the project, e.g. /leads.

type.description: Type is none or api_key; the key is passed via X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer.

summary.description: Summary are the non-secret fields that tell credentials apart in lists.

credentialType.description: CredentialType is the credential type a credential widget selects.

display.description: Display is the presentation of the widget, e.g. radio for select, response / optional for body.

key.description: Key is the property name in the config object, empty for display-only widgets such as branches.

resets.description: Resets are the fields cleared when this field changes, e.g. the filters when the table changes.

secret.description: Secret marks a credential field that is stored encrypted and never returned to the frontend.

showIf.description: ShowIf is another field of the same config; this field is hidden while that one is empty.

widget.description: Widget is value, number, select, text, email, password, credential, table, filters, sort, fieldMapping, conditions, headers, body, status or branches.

event.description: Event is the triggering event of the async flow, request_received or succeeded, or the trigger type for the main flow.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: HasUnpublishedChanges indicates the draft has been modified since the latest publishing.

method.description: Method and Path are the entry of the API trigger in the draft, empty for other triggers.

publishedMethod.description: PublishedMethod and PublishedPath are the API entry being served, empty if unpublished or for other triggers.

triggerType.description: TriggerType is the trigger type of the draft, PublishedTriggerType is the trigger type of the published revision, empty if unpublished.

action.description: Action marks external side effects; simulated debugging only computes the arguments.

branches.description: Branches marks modules with then / else branches.

category.description: Category groups the module in the node picker, one of ModuleCategories.

flows.description: Flows are the allowed flows: sync (the API sync flow), async (API async flows) and background (the main flow of other triggers).

idBase.description: IDBase is the prefix of new step IDs, e.g. query, query2.

plugin.description: Plugin is the installed plugin implementing the module, nil for built-in modules; texts of plugin modules are plain text rather than i18n keys.

tableKey.description: TableKey is the config field referencing a table.

terminal.description: Terminal marks modules that return the response and end the sync flow.

enabled.description: Enabled is false when the admin disabled the plugin: its steps are kept but can not be added, published or executed.

secretsReady.description: SecretsReady is false if auth.secret_key is not configured, in which case secret fields can not be saved.

items.description: Items is the element type of an array, record for table records.

kind.description: Kind is string, number, boolean, object, array or record; record expands the fields of the table given by TableKey.

default.description: Default is filled in only when the parameter is missing and must match the type.

id.description: ID is the stable identifier of the parameter; renaming the parameter does not change it.

itemType.description: ItemType is the array element type, string or number.

key.description: Key is the parameter's name in its source, e.g. a JSON property name or a query parameter name.

options.description: Options are the allowed enum values; when non-empty, they also constrain the elements of string arrays.

pattern.description: Pattern is the regular expression a string must match.

queued.description: Queued is false for a dry run, which only lists the flows that would be triggered.

credential.description: Credential is the credential type defined by the plugin, nil if there is none.

domains.description: Domains are the hosts the node can fetch, including their subdomains; * allows any public host.

id.description: ID is the id of the manifest; the steps of the node have the type plugin:<id>.

language.description: Language is the source language, javascript or typescript.

module.description: Module is the node DSL rendered by the workflow editor.

source.description: Source is the source code, only returned when getting a single plugin.

sourceURL.description: SourceURL is the address the source was downloaded from, empty if uploaded or written by hand.

timeout.description: Timeout is the time limit of a call in seconds.

usedBy.description: UsedBy is the number of workflows whose draft or published revision uses the node.

limit.description: Limit is the maximum number of requests allowed per window.

window.description: Window is the window length in seconds.

dateFieldUID.description: DateFieldUID is the date field for date_reached, and Offset is the offset in minutes from the field's time; negative means earlier.

fields.description: Fields are the field UIDs watched by record_updated; empty means any field.

filters.description: Filters are the conditions a record must satisfy and may only use constant values; record_matched requires at least one condition, and Match is all or any.

restoredFrom.description: RestoredFrom is the version this revision rolls back to, 0 if published from the draft.

request.description: Request, Event, Response, Trace and Error are only returned in the detail, Event is the trigger data of a background trigger.

trigger.description: Trigger is the source of the run: http, debug, or the trigger type of a background trigger.

interval.description: Interval is the interval for minutes and hours; a minute interval is at least 5.

start.description: Start is the local time of the first run, formatted as 2006-01-02T15:04.

weekdays.description: Weekdays are the days of the week for weekly runs; 0 is Sunday.

extra.description: Extra is a compact field shown on the right of the section title.

config.description: Config is the module configuration defined by the DSL of the type (see ModuleDef), decoded as the matching *XxxConfig.

then.description: Then and Else are the branches of a branching module (condition).

type.description: Type is a built-in module (query, create, update, condition, response, email, http) or an installed plugin (plugin:<id>).

requires.description: Fallback is shown while the Requires field is empty.

branch.description: Branch is the branch a condition node entered, then or else.

logs.description: Logs are the lines printed by a plugin node.

output.description: Output is the truncated step output.

reused.description: Reused means an async retry reused the output of the previous successful attempt.

api.description: API is the request endpoint, authentication and parameters of an api trigger.

name.description: Name is the display name of the trigger node; when empty, the trigger type's name is shown.

record.description: Record is the table watched by record triggers and date_reached.

schedule.description: Schedule is the execution time of a schedule trigger.

async.description: Async holds the flows an API trigger runs in the background after request events; empty for other triggers.

steps.description: Steps is the main flow: executed synchronously to build the response for API triggers, and in the background for other triggers.

timezone.description: Timezone is the IANA time zone in which formulas handle dates, e.g. Asia/Shanghai; UTC is used when it is empty or invalid.
